section: National Bank of Canada Montreal HQ: customer background, hybrid-work vision and why AVI-SPL Canada was chosen
body:
This is the opening part of AVI-SPL's case study on National Bank of Canada's Montreal headquarters. It gives the customer profile, the need and the reasons the bank picked AVI-SPL Canada, which makes it useful proof for financial services customers planning a large headquarters project.

**Who the customer is**
- National Bank of Canada is described as Canada's sixth-largest bank and the leading bank in Quebec. It serves individuals, businesses and clients at home and internationally, and has done so since 1859.
- Case study data: location Montreal, QC, Canada; market Financial Services.
- Solution brands listed: Biamp, Bose, Epson, HP | Poly, Legrand AV, Microsoft Teams, Peerless-AV, Q-SYS, Samsung, Sennheiser.

**The headquarters**
- In 2018 the bank began work on National Bank Place, a headquarters in downtown Montreal meant as a place where employees, clients and the local business community could collaborate.
- The design includes floor-to-ceiling windows and a large lobby fitted with museum-quality art, audio equipment, digital displays and massive video walls. Other spaces include auditoriums, a cafeteria, a wellness center, huddle spaces, large conference rooms and multi-purpose common areas.
- Manuel Vallée Léger, Experience Leader, Physical Workplace at National Bank, said the building was planned around a hybrid work model. The case study says this approach helped headquarters staff grow from 8,000 to 11,000.

**The need**
- Changes in AV/UC technology and in user needs meant the bank's collaboration infrastructure needed future-ready upgrades.
- In 2022 the bank looked for third-party help to optimize forty floors of meeting spaces, plus the lobby, auditoriums, wellness space and cafeteria.

**Why AVI-SPL Canada**
The case study gives these reasons:
- expertise in designing and deploying audiovisual and unified communications
- an AV solution that balanced innovation with ease of use and scalability
- global reach, meaning the ability to serve the bank's offices in Canada, New York and London
- bilingual support
- strong commitments on corporate social responsibility

Maxime Migneault, AV Solutions Integrator at National Bank, said the bank felt well looked after by the AVI-SPL team.

**When to use this**
Use it when a customer asks for a banking or large headquarters reference, or asks what criteria a comparable organisation used to select an AV/UC partner.

**Not stated in this source**: project cost or contract value.
